title: [PATCH] Virtual ethernet device (v2.1)

date.notes: Wed, 11 Jul 2007 13:31:15 +0400 = 2007-07-11 09:31:15 UTC; resubmission with complete patch.

publisher_or_issuer: netdev mailing list; preserved by Openwall

fixity.scan_notes: SHA-256 and byte size identify the saved Openwall HTML response accessed 2026-09-08, including archive navigation, not an original RFC822 message. The complete message body was read and checked against the saved HTML. No message body is redistributed in this repository.

redistribution_notes: Metadata, access link and bounded claim summaries only; public access does not establish permission to redistribute the full correspondence.

claims_extracted.claim: The opening says the netlink NEWLINK interface is now in the netdev tree and resubmits veth for inclusion; the description contrasts etun's sysfs interface.
claims_extracted.locator: Opening beginning 'Since the netlink NEWLINK interface'; description beginning 'Eric recently sent a similar driver'
claims_extracted.notes: This dates the author's resubmission statement, not NEWLINK's exact introduction commit.

claims_extracted.claim: The complete v2.1 patch still uses dedicated MAC attributes, a string-valued VETH_INFO_PEER with enum value 2, and alloc_netdev plus manual copying marked 'in sync with rtnl_newlink'.
claims_extracted.locator: veth_newlink, veth_policy and include/net/veth.h in the complete patch
claims_extracted.notes: The final SRC-0269 driver instead uses generic IFLA attributes, peer enum value 1 and rtnl_create_link. No complete intermediate patch concordance is claimed.

notes: The quoted NEWLINK opening supports the API spelling; RTM_NRELINK in the description is a contemporary typo. The changelog does not substitute for the uncollected earlier v2 message.
